codes.evidence_quote: una de las figuras del cante más importante de nuestro tiempo
codes.rationale: The passage canonizes Camarón by ranking him among the most important cante figures of his time.

codes.evidence_quote: Por su personal manera de decir el cante, por el sonido de su voz, demostró ser un cantaor trascendental dentro del mundo del Flamenco.
codes.rationale: The text applies aesthetic criteria of personal delivery and vocal sound to define Camarón's flamenco importance.

codes.evidence_quote: se trata de un cante auténtico, saturado de pureza y genialidad
codes.rationale: The passage explicitly attributes authenticity and purity to Camarón's cante as a legitimating claim.

possible_but_not_emitted.reason: The passage mentions tradition and synchronizing the archaic with the modern, but the stronger visible discourse function is authenticity/evaluation rather than tradition as an independent authority claim.
Aficionados are mentioned as mourners and followers, but they are not clearly positioned as authoritative judges in the visible text.

derived_analysis.target: Camarón de la Isla and his cante

codes.evidence_quote: Camarón logró como nadie el privilegio de sacudir las fibras más sensibles sólo con su presencia, con su cante crispado y masculino
codes.rationale: The passage evaluates Camarón through emotional force, vocal expressivity, and affective power as aesthetic criteria.

codes.evidence_quote: Sobre todo para su pueblo, para su raza, que veían en él al elegido, al artista ungido
codes.target: Camarón as representative of his people/race
codes.rationale: Identity-group framing organizes Camarón's authority as an artist chosen by and meaningful to his people and race.

codes.evidence_quote: ese es el privilegio de los genios
codes.rationale: Calling Camarón one of the genios elevates him into an exemplary hierarchy of exceptional artists.

possible_but_not_emitted.reason: The text invokes old masters, ancestors, and flamenco rivers, but this functions poetically more than as a clear tradition-continuity authority claim.
The community's devotion is visible, but the passage does not clearly make aficionados or community participants judges of flamenco value.

codes.evidence_quote: El cante de Camarón es rancio y radical, nuevo y liberador
codes.rationale: The passage defines the quality of Camarón's cante through aesthetic criteria of depth, radicality, novelty, and liberation.

codes.evidence_quote: Incluso en las grabaciones «comerciales» de José está presente siempre el soplo sublime del ángel o el vendaval arrebatador del duende.
codes.rationale: The text explicitly praises even the commercial recordings as possessing sublime and duende-like artistic force.
The quoted reaction elevates Camarón into an exceptional, near-divine artistic hierarchy.

possible_but_not_emitted.reason: The passage mentions interpreting classics and listening to old recordings, but it does not clearly frame learning, access, or transmission.
Commercial recordings are mentioned, but the text does not frame commerce as weakening or strengthening authenticity in a sustained way.

codes.evidence_quote: Pocas veces se esforzó en revalorizar el auténtico cante gitano-andaluz
codes.rationale: The passage explicitly invokes authentic gitano-Andalusian cante as a valued category, even while saying Camarón did not chiefly revalorize it.

codes.evidence_quote: Fue, en síntesis, la asignatura pendiente de los clásicos y el eterno interrogante del futuro.
codes.rationale: The passage places Camarón in a canonizing historical frame between the classical tradition and the future of flamenco.

codes.evidence_quote: Su gran mérito fue que sin ser rechazado, se permitió el lujo de presentar un producto muy diferente de aquel al que el aficionado estaba acostumbrado.
codes.rationale: The text explicitly evaluates Camarón's merit in presenting a markedly different flamenco language.

possible_but_not_emitted.reason: The aficionado appears as a reference audience, but not as an authoritative community actor.
Duendes are mentioned, but not clearly applied as a distinct evaluative criterion beyond the broader critical judgment already coded.

codes.evidence_quote: siendo requerido para actuar en los festivales andaluces como primera figura y con la máxima cotización económica del momento dentro del género flamenco
codes.rationale: The passage ranks Camarón as a first-rank figure with maximal status within flamenco performance circuits.

codes.evidence_quote: puede decirse que empieza una nueva época por su gran influencia
codes.rationale: The quoted commentary canonizes Camarón as inaugurating a new epoch through his influence.

codes.evidence_quote: su jondismo está latente en su rajo, en su voz gitanísima
codes.rationale: The passage applies aesthetic criteria of jondismo, rajo, and gitano vocal quality to explain his flamenco value.

possible_but_not_emitted.reason: Young singers imitate him, but the visible text frames this mainly as influence and style formation rather than a learning/access discourse.
Aficionados are mentioned as audiences created by him, but not clearly as community authorities who judge or sustain value.
The phrase voz gitanísima invokes identity, but it functions primarily as an aesthetic criterion rather than broader identity-based authority framing.
